title: Simulated trading session — 20 symbols, 24 h pre-historic + 12 h run

caps.source: x01 defaults (no live caps in the settings)

Paper.slowest: select 192 · candidates 197 · entries 29 ms over 8570 (wall, sliced) · 42334 older tape positions left to their tape

openEnd.rule: exact: the orders the engine executed in the run and still open at its end (every gate, cap and Block volume applied), marked to market at the last close

caps.source: x01 defaults (no live caps in the settings)

checks.name: Σ hourly orders closed = total orders
Σ hourly orders opened = total orders
Σ hourly positions closed = positions closed
Σ hourly positions opened = positions (closed + open at the end)
positions open(h) = open(h−1) + opened(h) − closed(h), every hour
Σ engine + signals net = total net
Σ per-range net = total net (Signals a range of their own)
minute book = its second pass (max equity drawdown)
Σ hour × type net = total net
Σ hour × source net = signal net
equity = balance at every hour end with no open order
orders inside the window (entry ≥ start, exit ≤ end)
order keys unique (cfg · symbol · entry → one unit each)
heatmap: the executed engine orders of every cell add up to the engine's orders with a cell
heatmap: every executed cell is a computed cell
coverage: every combo evaluated at Base (engine + signal combos)
coverage: range mc has config sets
coverage: range sh has config sets
coverage: range gn has config sets
coverage: range lg has config sets
config sets: every grid cell accounted (built + not built = grid)
config sets: every built config kept or dropped for too few closes
memory: the reported compute ran at the full level (no memory fallback)
hour × type: the type columns add up to the orders closed, every hour

definitions.pf: gross profit $ ÷ gross loss $ of the closed orders (∞ = no losing order; the engine caps that case at 4)
definitions.net: Σ r × unit of the closed orders, $ (r already holds the 0.2 % round-trip cost, the Block multiple and the DCA legs)
definitions.ddt: drawdown time, h: the longest time the closed-order curve stayed below a previous peak (an unrecovered one counts to the end of the window)
definitions.ddr: drawdown ratio: the closed-order curve's max drawdown ÷ its net ($); – when net ≤ 0
definitions.maxDdPct: group: max drawdown of its own closed curve ÷ (start balance + curve peak); total: the equity curve (open orders marked to market every minute)
definitions.ddNow: equity drawdown time at the end of the hour: hours since the minute equity last stood at its peak
definitions.positions: symbol × direction episodes: overlapping orders on one symbol and side form one position (per group: episodes of that group's orders)
definitions.greenHours: hours whose closed orders netted > 0 (of the hours with closes)
definitions.hourBucket: an order belongs to the hour of its close (h, h + 1 h]; opened = entries in [h, h + 1 h)
definitions.subType: Plain = executed at ×1; Block Active = raised by Block at level ≥ 5 (with Block Active on every executed entry must be raised)
definitions.margin: Σ unit × volume ÷ leverage of the open orders
definitions.mtm: open orders marked at the last 1m close (price at minute t = close of the bar that opened at t − 1 min), less the round-trip cost; a DCA order is marked with its full final volume from its entry
definitions.unitPf: the same orders each at one unit of notional (r carries the Block multiple and DCA legs): the engine's PF, independent of the compounding equity sizing
definitions.variantEffect: walk-forward variants (one switch flipped against the options as run, on the same tapes): changes results = a different order set; changes volume = the same orders at other volumes / results; no effect = the identical trade set; n/a = the switch has nothing to act on; needs a recompute = it shapes the tapes when they are built. Net and PF in trade % (Σ r × 100, one unit per order)
definitions.sizingReplay: the live control's sizing replayed on the baseline's positions every 5 minutes, equity = the report's balance curve: top configs → per-position cap and exchange minimum → exposure scaler → stop-risk budget → worst-case budget → exchange orders against the held book (rebalance threshold). Sizing only: no fills, slippage or control stops
